subject: Deku Scrub Merchant
text: As child Link, the Deku Scrub Merchant is past the skull kid room and at the far end of the bridge room in the Lost Woods, selling Deku Sticks for 40 rupees.

evidence.quote: As kid Link, when you first enter the lost woods from the korki forest, take a left, pass the room with skull kid, then clime down to the opposite end of the room with the bridge and you will find a Deku Scrub Merchant asking for 40 rupees for Deku Sticks.

subject: Hylian Shield chest
object: buying the Hylian Shield in the bazaar
text: Buying the shield in the bazaar replaces the shield chest with a rupee chest, so the achievement can be permanently missed.

evidence.quote: Don't buy the shield from the bazaar or else the chest that gives you this achievement will be replaced with a chest that contains rupees instead.

subject: Hylian Shield
text: The achievement can still be earned after buying the shield: let a Like Like steal it, then kill the Like Like and open the chest afterwards.

evidence.quote: You can still get this achievement even if you buy the shield in the bazaar, just have a LikeLike in the Fire Temple or Bottom of the Well steal it from you and go open the chest afterwards.

subject: Like Like trick
text: A player reports the Like Like shield trick failed in the Fire Temple but worked in Bottom of the Well, and says kid Link is needed.

evidence.quote: Then tried again in Bottom of the Well and got it. You probably need to be kid Link to get this way.

subject: Like Like trick
text: One player says the Like Like trick did not work for them and they had to start a new save to get the shield from the Kakariko Graveyard chest.

evidence.quote: I tried the Like Like trick and it did not pop. Had to spin up a new save file to grab it from the chest in Kakariko Graveyard.

subject: Like Like trick
text: The Like Like trick works, but only as child Link; it did not pop as adult Link.

evidence.quote: As of 7/17/25, the LikeLike trick DOES provide the achievement. But you have to be a child. It did not pop for me as an adult.

subject: Like Like trick
text: If you buy the shield at the Bazaar, let a Like Like swallow you and kill it; the achievement pops when you pick up the shield.

evidence.quote: If you buy the shield from the Bazaar, just let a Like Like swallow you and when you eliminate it, the achievement pops when you pick up the shield.

subject: Hylian Shield
text: Lose the shield to a Like Like and recover it, or as child Link, drag a tombstone with flowers at night in Kakariko Graveyard.

evidence.quote: You just need to lose your shield to a Like-Like and recover it later, or as a child, drag a tombstone with flowers at night in Kakariko Graveyard.

subject: Hylian Shield
text: After leaving Kokiri Forest and before seeing Zelda, one can go straight to Kakariko Graveyard, move the grave and take the shield.

evidence.quote: just by the time you can exit Kokiri Forest, you can go straight to Kakariko and enter the graveyard, move the grave and take your shield, before seeing zelda.

subject: Cucco
object: attacking Cuccos until they attack back
text: Attack a Cucco until the chickens start attacking to earn the achievement.

evidence.quote: Attack a Cucco until the chickens start attacking.

subject: Cucco's Revenge
text: The achievement only works as child Link; attacking the Cucco in the windmill as adult Link does not unlock it.

evidence.quote: the achievement only works as child. It won't unlock if you attack the Cucco that's in the windmill as adult

subject: Goron City bomb tunnel
text: Bomb the rolling Goron in the enclosed area, the tunnel where he rolls into, to earn the achievement.

evidence.quote: You got to bomb him in the enclosed area, the tunnel where he rolls into.

subject: Goron rolling bombing
text: Bombing the Goron outside the enclosed tunnel did not work for one player, costing 80 rupees in bombs.

evidence.quote: I wondered why it didn't work for me just now and RIP 80 Rupees for all the bombs.

subject: Goron rolling bombing
text: The achievement was completed with 2 of the remaining 9 bombs.

evidence.quote: Still had 9 left and managed to do it with 2 of those just now, yay.

subject: Goron City boulder room
text: The achievement is missable because the entrance rocks have permanent flags, so destroying them can prevent it.

evidence.quote: This is missable, cause rocks in entrance have perma flags.

subject: Goron City boulder room
text: Instead of following the title's method, you can jump to the side of the entrance rocks.

evidence.quote: A tip: you can just jump to the side of them if you don't feel like doing what the title suggest

subject: Goron City boulder room
text: Enter Goron City, keep the three boulders on the left intact, cross the tightrope to the left, enter the boulder room and open the treasure chest there.

evidence.quote: When you enter Goron City, there are three boulders to your left... don't destroy those, go onto the tightrope and cross to the left, then enter the boulder room and get the treasure there and boom cheevment.

subject: Goron City boulder room
text: Rocks inside the treasure chest room can be destroyed.

evidence.quote: Yes, you can destroy the rocks in the treasure chest room
